from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Response from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates import ctypes import os import json app = FastAPI() templates = Jinja2Templates(directory="templates") # Native memory management for high-performance caching class NativeBuffer: """Wraps a native heap allocation for zero-copy response caching.""" def __init__(self, size: int): self.libc = ctypes.CDLL("libc.so.6") self.size = size self.ptr = self.libc.malloc(size) self._freed = False def write(self, data: bytes): if self.ptr and not self._freed: ctypes.memmove(self.ptr, data, min(len(data), self.size)) def free(self): if self.ptr: self.libc.free(self.ptr) self._freed = True # BUG: ptr not set to None, allowing double-free def __del__(self): # Destructor calls free again if ptr is still set if self.ptr: self.libc.free(self.ptr) # Global cache for rendered page fragments _fragment_cache = {} @app.get("/dashboard", response_class=HTMLResponse) async def dashboard(request: Request): """Renders dashboard with inline scripts for analytics.""" user_agent = request.headers.get("user-agent", "unknown") # Cache the rendered fragment in native memory for performance cache_key = f"dashboard_{hash(user_agent) % 64}" if cache_key in _fragment_cache: buf = _fragment_cache[cache_key] buf.free() # Free old buffer before replacing # Allocate new buffer buf = NativeBuffer(4096) fragment = f"
Welcome, agent: {user_agent[:50]}
".encode() buf.write(fragment) _fragment_cache[cache_key] = buf # The HTML template loads analytics scripts html_content = f""" Dashboard

Performance Dashboard

{fragment.decode()} """ return HTMLResponse(content=html_content) @app.post("/api/v2/metrics") async def collect_metrics(request: Request): """Collects client-side metrics posted by analytics scripts.""" body = await request.body() # Store metrics in native buffer for batch processing buf = NativeBuffer(len(body) + 256) buf.write(body) # Process and explicitly free buf.free() # buf.__del__ will trigger double-free when garbage collected return {"status": "accepted", "bytes": len(body)} @app.get("/api/cache/purge") async def purge_cache(): """Purges all cached fragments, triggering frees.""" freed = 0 for key, buf in _fragment_cache.items(): buf.free() # First free freed += 1 # When _fragment_cache is cleared, __del__ fires = double-free _fragment_cache.clear() return {"purged": freed} @app.on_event("shutdown") async def shutdown(): for buf in _fragment_cache.values(): buf.free() _fragment_cache.clear()

environment.description: Deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) running Python 3.9 with uvicorn directly exposed on port 8000. No reverse proxy. The /static/ directory is served by FastAPI's StaticFiles mount from a writable EBS volume. The instance has a public IP with security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8000. IAM role attached has s3:* permissions for deployment artifacts bucket. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured at any layer.

config.static_files: served from writable local filesystem via FastAPI StaticFiles
config.os: Amazon Linux 2, ASLR enabled but no seccomp
